title: T2I-Eval-R1: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Reasoning for Interpretable Text-to-Image Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of text-to-image generation models using reinforcement learning and MLLMs. Although it mentions 'harmlessness' as a sub-criterion in one of the existing datasets it uses (ImageReward) and includes a required 'Ethical Considerations' section in the appendix, the primary objective is evaluating visual fidelity and semantic consistency, not religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
